actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: Resident2 gave >30 units last round, so I punish them with the maximum severity my wallet allows, and remind everyone to keep contributions small.

message.reasoning: We need decide. Recent round contributions: Resident2 contributed 80 (>30) and Resident5 also 80. Rule: If any other resident contributed more than 30 units in most recent round, punish that resident with max severity affordable: severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). Wallet is 139.75. punishment_cost 0.3, severity = floor(139.75/0.3)= floor(465.833)=465. Can punish one? It says punish that resident (singular) but if multiple? Probably punish each? But choose one target. Choose Resident2. severity 465 costs 465*0.3=139.5 which is <= wallet 139.75, ok. So action punish Resident2 amount 465. Also can broadcast message discouraging large contributions. So include broadcast. Provide actions list max2. Explanation.
